title: `entire enable --force` exits 0 and refreshes nothing without a TTY, though doctor and status prescribe it

verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the agent-management flow in setup.go (renaming, deselection, non-interactive skill guidance), but none of it shows that `--force` without a TTY was meant to bail out with exit 0 and refresh nothing. The non-interactive branch looks like a side effect of the selection-flow design, not a choice about `--force`.

and discovery executes what it finds. findInaccessiblePlugin carried the same
rule separately, which is how the two drifted; one helper keeps them aligned.
